title: AI Image to Video — Control Motion, Shape and Loop Seams
description: Making a still move is easy; keeping the subject undistorted is not. Set motion strength, hold the shape, then repair loop seams in Touch Edit before export.

seo.description: AI image to video: control motion strength and subject shape across the clip, then fix loop seams in Touch Edit so the result plays as a clean loop.
